name: Jedi training droid
description: The Jedi training droids were a model of droid used for various purposes in the Jedi Temple on Coruscant including verbally teaching a Padawan about Force-enhanced abilities and lightsaber practice. While a range of different forms and models existed, the droids were primarily skeletal bipeds, based on a humanoid frame.

data.name: Jedi training droid
data.manufacturer: Upgrades and different models made by Kazdan Paratus
